Suvarna Projects Limited 
 
 Government of India / State Authority · Delhi · IN 
 
 
 Work Completion CertifiCate 
 
 Issued under the provisions of the General Conditions of Contract
 
 Ref: CC/46/2017/076 Date: March 31, 2026 
 
 1. partiCulars of the Work 
 
 
 Set out below is the particulars of the work executed and the terms on which it was awarded,
 reconciled against the underlying vouchers before issue. 
 
 Name of Work Check Dam - Delhi Pkg-76 
 
 Nature / Category Irrigation 
 
 Contract / Tender Reference N/A 
 
 Contract Value (Original) INR 37.04 Cr 
 
 Completion Date 2017-10-23 
 
 Defect Liability Period N/A days from completion 
 
 Agency (Contractor) National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. 
 
 GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1 
 
 PAN NAICC4417O 
 
 Contractor's Project Manager Sunita Joshi 
 
 2. sCope of Work exeCuted 
 
 
 Irrigation works for Suvarna Projects Limited completed 2017. 
 The work was carried out under site conditions that included expansive clay in the sub-grade
 
 requiring additional treatment. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse
 to the department for additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to
 
 keep the critical path intact. 
 An extension of time was granted during execution on account of an extended monsoon which
 
 suspended earthwork for several weeks. The delay was examined by this office and held to be
 beyond the agency's control; no compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-076 Page 1 of 3

The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the
 approved drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has
 been completed in all respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief /
 
 Superintending Engineer. 
 
 3. Quality assessment 
 
 The overall quality of the completed work is graded Satisfactory. Workmanship was acceptable
 
 with minor rework at two locations, and the work was inspected in stages, with each stage
 recorded in the measurement book. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test
 
 results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.
 
 Parameter Assessment Remarks 
 
 Workmanship Satisfactory As per IS codes and approved specifications
 
 Material Quality Satisfactory Test certificates on record 
 
 Dimensional Compliance Satisfactory Verified against approved drawings 
 
 Safety Compliance Satisfactory BOCW Act provisions followed 
 
 4. milestone status 
 
 The table below sets out the milestone position as recorded at the time of handover, compiled
 
 from the records maintained by this office. 
 
 Milestone Planned Date Actual Date Status 
 
 Site Mobilisation 2017-10-23 2017-10-23 ✅ Completed 
 
 Execution Phase 2017-10-23 2017-10-23 ✅ Completed 
 
 Final Inspection 2017-10-23 2017-10-23 ✅ Completed 
 
 
 5. defiCienCy / observation list 
 
 At the time of taking over, kerb alignment corrected over a 40 m stretch after joint inspection.
 Regarding site safety, no lost-time injury was reported over the contract period. The agency's
 
 conduct during the contract is recorded as prompt and well documented. 
 
 Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2017-10-23. All
 minor observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the
 satisfaction of the inspecting authority. 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-076 Page 2 of 3

6. reCommendation 
 
 Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of
 the joint measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and
 
 recommend release of the balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of
 the defect liability period. Certified by V. Kulkarni, Project Director.
 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and
 contract conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection
 
 carried out by the undersigned. 
 This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the
 
 contractor of any obligations under the contract, including the defect liability period.
 CONFIDENTIAL - FOR AUTHORISED USE ONLY 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 V. Kulkarni, Project Director 
 Suvarna Projects Limited 
 
 Delhi, India 
 Date: March 31, 2026 Sunita Joshi 
 Project Manager 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-076 Page 3 of 3
